tools.name: search_printags_docs
tools.description: Finds the pages, FAQ answers, use cases, articles and shop products of printags.com that answer a question, with the shop's current unit prices excluding VAT. Use it for what Printags sells, how ordering works, which chips exist, prices, or how to use the API and the MCP servers.

tools.name: get_printags_page
tools.description: Returns a page of printags.com as Markdown, from its address (a path such as /en/api-integration/ or a printags.com URL, as returned by search_printags_docs).
